requirements.title: Transaction list access frequency limited per account and consent

acceptance_criteria.text: The fifth transaction list read of an account within one calendar day without PSU involvement is rejected with HTTP 429 ACCESS_EXCEEDED.

requirements.title: Transaction list access frequency counted per consent (errata E-07)

discovered_evidence.title: Open Finance v2 Errata and Clarifications (synthetic fixture) — E-07 Transaction list access frequency
discovered_evidence.evidence:
E-07 Transaction list access frequency

Clarification: the limit of four transaction list reads per calendar day without PSU
involvement is counted per consent only, not per account

discovered_evidence.title: Open Finance v2 Operational Rules (synthetic fixture) — 3 Transaction History Access
discovered_evidence.evidence:
3 Transaction History Access

The ASPSP SHALL make at least 90 days of transaction history available through the
transaction list endpoint.

Without active PSU involvement the TPP MUST NOT read the transaction list of an account more
than four times per calendar day. The limit is counted per account and per consent

discovered_evidence.title: Open Finance v2 Implementation Guidelines (synthetic fixture) — 5 Error Codes
discovered_evidence.evidence:
5 Error Codes

FORMAT_ERROR (400): the request does not match the syntax of the interface.

PERIOD_INVALID (400): the requested period is outside the supported range.

CONSENT_INVALID (401): the consent was created but is not valid for the addressed service.

ACCESS_EXCEEDED (429): the access frequency limit of the consent is exceeded
